comments.body_html: Hey there just reaching out as i am unable to get my game to load the main menu with the raffica mod installed on 3.9.8. All the other ones work fine but i get the endless loading screen circle once i add the raffica in. Ive tried loading at the top, middle, and bottom of this mod list im running. Any info would be greatly appreciated!

comments.author: Choccy Milk
comments.body_html: The latest version of the mod now uses MongoID. If you’ve played on a previous version and bought the item chances are the old ID is causing the issue. You would need to delete the item from your inventory and buy them back
